name: aviz-food-point-pos
description: Cloud POS for Avi's Food Corner — fast tablet billing for a vegetarian Indian food stall.

scripts.test:rules: firebase emulators:exec --only firestore --project demo-aviz-pos "vitest run -c vitest.rules.config.ts"
scripts.emulators: npm run build:functions && cross-env FUNCTIONS_DISCOVERY_TIMEOUT=60 firebase emulators:start --project demo-aviz-pos
scripts.dev:emu: npm run build:functions && concurrently -k -n emu,web "cross-env FUNCTIONS_DISCOVERY_TIMEOUT=60 firebase emulators:start --project demo-aviz-pos" "vite --mode emulator"
scripts.deploy:firebase-hosting: npm run build && firebase deploy --only hosting
